entries.speaker: Long-Haired Female Student
entries.en: This has to be about you-know-what,[n]right? With the principal...

entries.speaker: Vice Principal
entries.en: Ahem... We will now begin the emergency[n]morning assembly.

entries.speaker: Vice Principal
entries.en: As many of you may already know...[n]Principal Kobayakawa passed away[n]yesterday.

entries.speaker: Gossiping Female Student
entries.en: I wonder if that suicide rumor's for real...[n]It happened in front of the police station,[n]didn't it?

entries.speaker: Well-Behaved Female Student
entries.en: I think I was passing through there[n]at the time...

entries.speaker: Vice Principal
entries.en: The principal had been working hard to[n]restore peace ever since the incident[n]with Mr. Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Vice Principal
entries.en: He only wished for everyone to be able[n]to lead a normal school life, and because[n]of that love...

entries.speaker: Large Male Student
entries.en: Love? Bullshit. He was covering[n]something up. Everyone's been[n]talking about it.

entries.speaker: Gossiping Female Student
entries.en: Maybe it wasn't suicide... Do you think[n]the Phantom Thieves took him down!?

entries.speaker: Bored Male Student
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves? Do they kill[n]people?

entries.speaker: Large Male Student
entries.en: I mean, Kamoshida did say he was gonna[n]kill himself to make up for everything[n]he did.

entries.speaker: Gossiping Female Student
entries.en: That would be amazing! Either way,[n]it serves that principal right!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are people gonna blame us for this too?

entries.speaker: Vice Principal
entries.en: I would like to see everyone live up to[n]our late principal's wishes as proud[n]Shujin students, and...
